method: Local symbols were inspected in repository context. Official public authorities were inspected at the exact named sections. Metadata, locators, scope, and boundaries are retained; passages are not.

inspections.scope: Executes interval addition over canonical signed-i64 inputs with one explicit unit and independently recomputes the receipt output.
inspections.boundary: This proves only bounded interval addition; it does not establish general interval arithmetic or measurement validity.

inspections.locator: lib/deterministic-calculation.ts — newtonRoot and buildCalculation and assertCalculable

inspections.boundary: This proves a bounded Newton-method fixture, not convergence for arbitrary functions or a general root-finding service.

inspections.scope: Canonicalizes supported JSON values and emits a SHA-256 commitment that can be recomputed from the same non-empty payload.
inspections.boundary: A matching digest establishes byte-equivalent canonical content, not truth, authorship, timestamp, or legal signature.

inspections.scope: Publishes a typed synthetic fixture registry with expected outputs, refusals, checks, and one digest over the registry.
